{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Targa Resources Pipeline System''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2026/august/targa-plans-70-mi-permian-gas-pipeline-to-expand-waha-takeaway-capacity|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/refining-processing/news/55398842/targa-adding-midstream-infrastructure-amid-new-permian-agreements-with-exxonmobil|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/08/18/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/targa-resources-corp-announces-20-year-agreements-with-exxonmobil-and-announces-three-new-natural-gas-processing-plants-in-the-permian-delaware/2407144|title=manilatimes.net|website=manilatimes.net|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Texas to Waha Hub, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2026/august/targa-plans-70-mi-permian-gas-pipeline-to-expand-waha-takeaway-capacity|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/refining-processing/news/55398842/targa-adding-midstream-infrastructure-amid-new-permian-agreements-with-exxonmobil|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/08/18/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/targa-resources-corp-announces-20-year-agreements-with-exxonmobil-and-announces-three-new-natural-gas-processing-plants-in-the-permian-delaware/2407144|title=manilatimes.net|website=manilatimes.net|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
